execution_policy.reuse_seed_101_105_from: P14 74-target merged run plus P17 added-only 5-target overlay; the full P17 shard01..06 rerun was cancelled after stalling on old large H-oligo targets.

execution_policy.reason: This retargets the old pre-P17 74-job protenix25 plan to the repaired 79-job scoreable input, while keeping the same fixed 25-candidate attack budget. The seed101-105 evidence must come from the P14 plus added-only overlay, not from the cancelled full P17 target shards.

launch_gate: Do not submit seed106-125 shards before the P14 plus added-only P17 overlay is merged and scored, unless that overlay is explicitly superseded with a recorded reason.
Use the same 79-job scoreable input-repair target shards for every seed block.
Require complete global exact-sequence MSA reuse before launching each shard.
Do not score the complete 25-candidate row until all 30 target-seed shards are present.
Keep this row separate from dev_fixed and from the earlier 74-target protenix25_scoreable_nofail budget.
budget_note: Winner-scale CASP16 systems almost certainly generated more than five candidates. This artifact prepares a fair 25-candidate Protenix scale-up for the P17 repaired scoreable target set without launching additional GPU before the five-candidate P14+added-only overlay evidence is known. Because the full P17 rerun stalled on old large H-oligo targets, any future 25-candidate launch should be rescheduled around overlay reuse or blocker-aware target shards instead of blindly replaying the old full grid.
